explanation: Matches Conjecture 1 and Definition 2 of arXiv:2607.08630: s≥2, n=2^{s-1} nonzero vectors in F_2^s (possibly repeated) with sum 0 have a Hadamard pair solution, i.e. F_2^s partitions into n pairs with prescribed differences v_i. The Equiv from Fin n×Fin 2 to 𝔽₂ s is exactly such a partition, and e(i,0)+e(i,1)=v_i is the difference in characteristic 2.
